name: ia-details: no disc split
why: A show's files named "1-01. …" / "2-01. …" are two discs: one sub-table each, as release-tracks has one per medium.

name: ia-details: no derivative columns
why: vzell's answer Q3: a file's copies (VBR MP3, …) are columns of its row.

name: ia-details: no head sections
why: The item's subheader and its Description, Details and Pictures sections go above the tables, as release-tracks' (vzell 2026-11-04).

name: ia-details: a picture does not open the viewer
why: A click on a picture opens the artwork viewer on every picture of the item (_dpArtViewerClick on the Pictures section).

name: ia-details: All files shows the tracks
why: The second button lists every file, one row each.

name: ia-details: a video item gets its file list
why: A video item's table is its video files with a Play here tile.

name: ia-details: the item's own content has no previews
why: An item page is plain HTML; its content (main#maincontent) previews before any button.

name: ia-details: the toolbar named as a search
why: An item page's section is named after the item.
grep: the toolbar is named after the item

name: ia-details: Details and Pictures not opened
why: makeH2sCollapsible() starts every h2 but the data one closed; _iaDetailsOpenSections() opens Details and Pictures.

name: ia-details: Description starts open
why: Description starts closed, as a release's Annotation: only Details and Pictures carry data-mb-ia-open.

name: ia-details: Details cards do not fold
why: The Details cards fold on their heading, through the Sidebar section's shared _sbInlineWireFolds().

name: ia-details: sections inserted after the collapse pass
why: The sections go in BEFORE makeH2sCollapsible(), which makes their h2s collapsible; inserted after it they are plain headings.
